title: Free architect consultations in Tsukuba are open for October 27
summary: Ibaraki Prefecture is taking reservations for a free housing consultation in Tsukuba on October 27, 2026. Architects can answer technical questions about new homes and renovations; sessions are reservation-only and first-come, first-served.
why_it_matters: People planning a renovation or new home can get an independent technical check before spending money, and can bring drawings or photos for more specific advice.

sources.title: 令和８年度住まいの相談会（無料・予約制）の開催

claims.text: Ibaraki Prefecture's free, reservation-only housing consultation is scheduled at Tsukuba City Hall on October 27, 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00 excluding 12:00 to 13:00.
Reservations for the Tsukuba session opened September 1 and are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.
Architects answer technical questions on new construction and renovation, and the prefecture recommends bringing drawings or photos; contract disputes are outside the consultation's scope.

For a household already considering renovation or construction, a free technical consultation can reduce the chance of overlooking basic design or construction questions before committing to paid work.

content.who_is_affected: Ibaraki residents or prospective homeowners with technical questions about new construction or renovation, especially people able to attend Tsukuba City Hall.
content.financial_impact: The consultation itself is free. It is not a quotation service and does not resolve contractor disputes.
content.risk_if_ignored: Main risk is simply missing a free independent technical review if slots fill; this is not an urgent legal or financial deadline.
content.deadline: Reservation is already open and places are first-come, first-served.
content.potential_benefit: Get a qualified architect's view on technical housing questions before committing to a renovation or construction decision.
content.downside: You need to attend in person and the session cannot handle contract disputes.

30 sec: Free architect consultation in Tsukuba: October 27.
Bring drawings or photos for more useful technical advice.
reading_levels.2_min: Ibaraki Prefecture runs free housing consultation sessions where architects answer technical questions about building or renovating a home. The Tsukuba session is scheduled for October 27 at Tsukuba City Hall, with advance reservations already open and allocated first-come, first-served. Bring drawings or photos if they help explain the issue. The service is for technical housing questions, not disputes with contractors.

content.bottom_line: If you are already planning a home build or renovation, reserve a slot while available and bring the actual drawings, photos and specific questions.
